aboutPage.title: Mr. Ericson Piccoli and His Journey So Far
aboutPage.intro1: Mr. Ericson Piccoli is a Brazilian attorney with a solid academic background and extensive professional trajectory in the field of Law, marked by an internationalized approach, unwavering focus on the defense of fundamental rights and commitment to social justice.
aboutPage.intro2: With nearly eight years of continuous and qualified professional practice, he has developed expertise in various spheres of the justice system, from the Public Defender's Office to leading legal departments in international operations. He holds a Law degree from Univates, a postgraduate degree in Criminal Law and Criminology from PUC-RS, and executive certifications from Harvard University in leadership and entrepreneurship.
aboutPage.intro3: His journey includes experience as a research assistant at the Berkeley Judicial Institute (UC Berkeley), practice at a law firm in Miami (USA) in business law and intellectual property, and leadership of the legal department of a multinational company with operations in over 8 countries.
